body: RouteSync bulk dispatch exports started returning 502 errors this afternoon. Our team cannot finish tomorrow's route plan; 62 dispatchers depend on this flow across 480 routes.
We have reproduced the export failure and escalated it to engineering as P1. I will share another update by 18:00 UTC today.

This is now an executive escalation. If the service is not stable by Thursday, we will move dispatch planning off RouteSync and review our renewal. Please confirm the fix time, approve a service credit, and tell me whether automatic retry will be added.
I understand the severity and am coordinating with support and engineering. I will send you a consolidated update by 12:00 UTC on September 9.
It is past 12:00 UTC and we have not received the promised update. The workaround has not been explained to our operations leaders. I need a candid status and named next step today.
Thanks for the details; the requested information is attached to the ticket.
